headline: Senate resolution to request a State Department report on Honduras's human rights practices did not advance.
what_it_does: This resolution would have used section 502B(c) of the Foreign Assistance Act of 1961 to formally request information from the executive branch about human rights practices in Honduras. Under that law, such a request generally requires the State Department to provide a report within a set time, and security aid to the country can be affected if the report is not provided. The Senate did not take it up or end debate on it, so the request was not made.

who_it_affects.how: It would have been required to prepare and send the Senate a report on Honduras's human rights practices.
Its human rights record would have been formally reviewed, which could have bearing on US security assistance to the country.
